requirements.statement: A user can sign in to reach their own private todo list

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is prompted to sign in before seeing any todos
After signing in, the user is taken to their own todo list
A signed-in user's session persists across page reloads without requiring sign-in again

requirements.statement: A user can create a new todo

criteria.must: A signed-in user can submit text to create a new todo
A newly created todo appears in the user's list as not completed
A newly created todo is persisted so it still appears after reloading the app

requirements.statement: A user can view their own list of todos, showing pending and completed items

criteria.must: A signed-in user's todo list shows only todos they created
The todo list distinguishes pending todos from completed todos
The todo list is easy to scan and understand at a glance

requirements.statement: A user can mark one of their todos as complete

criteria.must: A signed-in user can mark one of their own pending todos as complete
A todo marked complete is shown as completed in the list
A completed todo's state is persisted so it still shows as completed after reloading the app
A user cannot mark another user's todo as complete
